topic: Why matching their first $20 of earnings changes everything
caption:
Match your teen's first $20 of earnings and watch their whole attitude change.

It's not about the money. It's the moment they realize their effort has real value.

Tell them upfront: earn $20 this week, and you'll double it. Then watch them figure it out.

HustleUp shows them exactly how to get there. See how it works → hustleup.us
